info.name: TIP Email Manager - Email Templates (EM-8 to EM-13)
info.description:
End-to-end tests for template authoring, edit, retire/reactivate, history/compare, restore, delete and maker-checker approval.

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner (they share state). Needs four users: maker, checker (Sr. Analyst/Manager), analyst, manager - set their JWTs in the environment.
The maker and checker MUST be different users (self-approval is blocked). Upload steps use files from postman/sample-files; set Postman's working directory to that folder.

item.name: A. Author new template (EM-8) and approve (EM-13)

request.description: Name uniqueness is case-insensitive among non-deleted templates.

item.name: A3 Content with a merge field that is not a query column -> conflict flagged
A4 Submit blocked by the merge-field conflict -> 409
A5 Content (valid merge field; script/onclick must be stripped)

exec: pm.test('allowed structure kept (heading, table, link)', () => { pm.expect(j.bodyHtml).to.include('<h1>'); pm.expect(j.bodyHtml).to.include('<table'); pm.expect(j.bodyHtml).to.include('href'); });

item.name: A7 Add attachment (.docx, stored in DB)

request.description: Select postman/sample-files/sample_attachment.docx (set Postman's working directory to the sample-files folder).

request.description: Validated against the existing distribution-list / contacts endpoints.

A12 Submit blocked by recipient-mapping conflict -> 409

request.description: No virus scan - the file is stored in-row (BYTEA) and parsed.

A19 FILE_UPLOAD: select sheet 'Recipients' -> header row
A20 FILE_UPLOAD: map a column that isn't in the sheet

exec: pm.test('2 invalid rows flagged (missing + malformed email)', () => pm.expect(j.recipientFileInvalidRowCount).to.eql(2));

item.name: A23 Submit with blank Approval Comments -> 400
A24 Submit with Approval Comments over 500 chars -> 400

exec: pm.test('Approval Comments echoed back', () => pm.expect(j.approvalComments).to.eql('Q3 reminder, ready for review'));
const hit = j.content.find(c => String(c.templateId) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get('tid')) && c.changeType === 'NEW_TEMPLATE');
pm.test('pending NEW_TEMPLATE request for this template is in the queue', () => pm.expect(hit).to.exist);

item.name: A29 Maker approves their own submission -> 403 (separation of duties)

request.description: Enforced by your SecurityFilterChain URL rules (approvers: TIP Admin / Sr. Analyst / Manager). Not part of this module's code - if your local profile permits all requests this will return 200/403 from the self-approval rule instead.

item.name: B. Edit existing template (EM-9), withdraw / reject / approve, history + compare (EM-11)
B1 Start edit -> v2 draft pre-filled from v1

exec: pm.test('subject carried over', () => pm.expect(j.subject).to.eql('Action needed: Q3 filing due'));
pm.test('recipient file + parsed rows carried over', () => { pm.expect(j.recipientFileName).to.eql('sample_recipients.xlsx'); pm.expect(j.recipientFileRowCount).to.eql(5); });

item.name: B2 Start edit again while a draft is open -> 409

exec: pm.test('no conflicts after adopt (assuming same columns)', () => pm.expect(j.hasMergeFieldConflict).to.eql(false));
pm.test('subject updated', () => pm.expect(j.subject).to.eql('EDITED v2: Q3 filing due'));

item.name: B18 Version history (checker): every status preserved

exec: pm.test('v1 SUPERSEDED, v2 WITHDRAWN, v3 REJECTED, v4 ACTIVE', () => { pm.expect(byNo[1].status).to.eql('SUPERSEDED'); pm.expect(byNo[2].status).to.eql('WITHDRAWN'); pm.expect(byNo[3].status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(byNo[4].status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });

exec: pm.test('single entry, the active version', () => { pm.expect(j.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j[0].status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });
